source.train_order: SW0130 source_contract(seed), first four registered TRAIN IDs and corresponding pool rows

screen.gamma: native128 RGB -> frozen registered encoder/statistics/clip -> native32 patch gamma; same per-image gamma reused across conditions
screen.state: reset theta, dendrite, membrane, and emitted-spike history for each image-condition pair
screen.none_parity: torch.equal on theta, mean membrane, mean spikes, component membrane, component spikes, and component gates against SW0134 late_rollout T=1024 live_tail_steps=0

conditions.kuramoto_interaction_off: set only Kuramoto K=0; preserve drive, initialization, graph, and all downstream equations
conditions.delayed_gate_constant_half: set the same gate g=0.5 in carrier=sin(theta)*g, integration input, emitted S=E*g, and exact-zero hold predicate
conditions.dendrite_history_off: h=(1+a_D*(u-1))*(1-beta_D)*dense; remove only explicit previous_h contribution, retaining dense previous-emitted-spike input
conditions.membrane_voltage_history_off: candidate=(1+a_M*(u-1))*((1-alpha_M)*R_m*sum(h)-v_d*S_prev); remove only explicit previous_mem contribution, retain reset and exact g==0 hold
conditions.binary_events_forced_on: set E=1 before emitted S=E*g and feed that emitted S into subsequent dendrite/reset recurrence; also record natural threshold events separately

invariants: All interventions rerun from t=0 through t=1023; no shortened horizon or settled-state initialization
Use the exact source batch-major component fold and production stack/permute/reshape layout
Exact zero-gate hold semantics; near-zero gate is not treated as zero
No checkpoint, source parameter, encoder, dataset, or production implementation mutation
Restore transient Kuramoto K after each condition
Record finite traces, literal gate/event/emitted-spike values, exact S=E*g, occupancy/transition/hold counts, per-field changes, runtime, and peak allocated/reserved memory
interpretation: A GT-free causal trace/resource screen only. It establishes neither segmentation quality nor learned-parameter usefulness, gate necessity, or a promotion decision. No full320 prediction/scoring stage is included in this screen.
